title: Scientists discover a plastic-eating “Pac-Man” enzyme with a surprising secret
caption:
Scientists discovered a 'Pac-Man' enzyme that helps bacteria break down biodegradable plastics in soil. Interestingly, this enzyme also shows an ability to dismantle penicillin, suggesting a link between plastic degradation and antibiotic resistance.

Source: Sciencedaily - Scientists discover a plastic-eating “Pac-Man” enzyme with a surprising secret
